newsitem.title: USA: Motorola rises on rating upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Motorola rises on rating upgrade.

text.p: Shares of technology giant Motorola Inc rose on Wednesday after the investment banking firm Morgan Stanley & Co said it upgraded its rating on the stock to outperform.
Morgan Stanley had previously rated Motorola as neutral. The brokerage also set a 12-month price target of $74 for the stock.
"I think the strength is probably 90 percent attributable to the Morgan upgrade," said one analyst, who asked not to be named.
Motorola closed 1-5/8 higher at 63-3/8 after hitting a high for the day of 63-7/8.

Motorola is due to release its fourth quarter earnings after the market closes on Thursday. First Call pegs the consensus of analysts' estimates at $0.41 a share versus $0.72 last year, a 43 percent fall, but analysts said there is some anticipation the company will beat expectations.
"It would not be wise for an analyst to do that (upgrade) without a high degree of confidence the company will at least meet or exceed the expectations," the analyst said.
